outline:
開課：機電、製科所合開（上學期）(含一般生、在職生)
本課程說明RFID系統架構，技術、編碼、和應用標準，資訊系統，效益評估，隱私權問題，及各領域或產業的創新應用和案例。
schedule:

02/27		Technology overview
03/05		Adv, limitation, Application types
03/12		RJ-Retail/CPG, Privacy/Security
03/19		Quiz, RJ-Healthcare/Pharma, EPC and standard
03/26		Team project meeting, project plan due
04/02		RJ-Chemical, RFID vs Barcode,
04/09		RJ-Manufacturing, RFID strategy
04/16		Midterm
04/23		RJ-Transport/Logistics, project status, Business justification
04/30		RJ-Defense/Aerospace, project status, RFID solution
05/07		RJ-Packaging/Labeling, project status, special topics
05/14		Business Trip
05/21		RJ-Apparel/Footwear, special topics, project report due
05/28		Team presentations
06/04		Quiz, team presentations
06/11		Team presentations
06/18		Final
assessment:
Test and grade
Quiz (20%)
Mid-term (40%)
Team project (40%)
